title: fix(spec,lint)!: deriveColumnSummary declares the stored value min / max answer, and object-grid sum / avg over a refused field type is refused at authoring
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiYaLGkzTcscdC6X2xzaDLws)_

Fixes #32144

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` and `content/docs/**` teach no `object-grid` `aggregations` entry and no return type of `deriveColumnSummary`; the reasoning ships as the `os explain grid-aggregation-field-type-refused` entry.

Both halves, in words: item 1 widens a published return type of `deriveColumnSummary` (the Claim's wording); item 2 narrows what authoring accepts for an `object-grid` aggregation, which is why the `Clause-②:` line carries the `(narrowing)` arm beside `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` (`check-changeset-no-major` refuses `narrowed` without it — see Acceptance notes).

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:协议里「按组汇总」读回函数 `deriveColumnSummary` 的声明类型改为如实:计数、求和、求平均、百分比类返回数字,最小/最大返回字段原值(日期就是日期文本);另外,页面上表格块(`object-grid`)对文本、日期、选项、关联、公式字段配置「求和/求平均」,保存时直接拒绝。
- **为什么改**:之前类型说「都是数字」,渲染端按数字读日期画出 `NaN`;而对文本求和这类配置,服务端分组查询会直接 400,浏览器分组则显示无意义的 0,作者在保存时却毫无提示。
- **风险与回滚**:运行时行为不变(只改类型声明);拒绝规则只拦 spec 聚合×字段类型表本就拒绝的组合,布尔字段照表放行;第一方(示例、hotcrm)此类配置为 0 处。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- **先看**:`packages/lint/src/validate-sortable-fields.ts` 的 `validateGridAggregations`(判据与跳过条件);`packages/spec/src/ui/view-grouping-query.ts` 的 `ColumnSummaryValue` 与 `deriveColumnSummary` 重载;`.changeset/32144-…md` 的声明行。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-sortable-fields.test.ts`,预期 96 条全绿,其中「object-grid aggregations over a refused field type」一组覆盖文本/日期/选项/关联/多选的拒绝与数字/布尔的放行。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**Item 1 — declare, do not normalise (`@objectstack/spec/ui`).** `deriveColumnSummary` is now generic over the summary it is handed and returns the new exported type `ColumnSummaryValue` of that summary, or `null` / `undefined`: `number` for `count`, `count_unique`, `sum`, `avg` and the four derived members, `unknown` for `min` / `max` (the aggregated field's stored value as the header row carries it: ISO text for a `datetime`, `YYYY-MM-DD` for a `date`), and `never` for `none`. A summary typed as the whole union reads `unknown`. The runtime body is unchanged except that the `as number | null` cast is gone. `ui/packages/plugin-grid` (`useGroupedData.ts` `readServerAggregations`, `useColumnSummary.ts`) drops its two local `: unknown` annotations, which the spec type now provides; `useWholeSetSummary.ts` needed no edit (it only names the function in prose).

**Item 2 — refuse (`@objectstack/lint`).** `validateSortableFields`, the member that already binds a page's `object-grid` block to its object and reaches the page publish door, gains `validateGridAggregations`: an `object-grid` `properties.aggregations` entry whose `type` is `sum` or `avg` over a field the aggregate × field-type table refuses is reported as `grid-aggregation-field-type-refused` at **`error`**. The verdict is `isAggregateCompatibleWithFieldType` from `@objectstack/spec/data`, the predicate the engine's `aggregate` door (`packages/objectql/src/aggregate-field-type-door.ts`) refuses the grouped header query by (`400 INVALID_FIELD`), so lint and door agree by construction; no second "numeric types" list, no zod refusal, no new gate script. The grade is the precedent's: the page-sort verdicts in the same member are `error` because a runtime door refuses them, and this pair is refused by a runtime door too. Binding: `dataSource.object` ahead of `properties.objectName` (the page-sort walk's order). Field types are read off the served object graph with tied fields dropped, so injected columns (`created_at`) and `objectExtensions` fields are judged by their own declaration. Skipped: unknown object / no field map, unresolved field, dotted path, tied field, typeless leaf (`id`), a type outside `FieldType`. `os explain grid-aggregation-field-type-refused` carries the reasoning.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/ui/view-grouping-query.test.ts`: `min` / `max` read the stored date / datetime text; `expectTypeOf` pins for every member family, the object form, `none`, and the whole-union input.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-sortable-fields.test.ts`: one refusal pin per refused family (text, textarea, date, datetime, injected `created_at`, select, lookup, tags), the remedy line read off the table, the `formula` remedy and `sum` × `percent`; passes for number / currency sum and avg, `avg` × percent, boolean and toggle; `count` over any field; `count_distinct` / `min` / `max` not judged; skips (unknown field, dotted, foreign object, unbound, `id`, a non-`FieldType` type, tied field) and the extension field judged; binding precedence; the `os explain` entry; the one-line verdict / fix shape tests now include this id.

## Acceptance notes

- **Booleans pass, deliberately.** The order's pin list named "text, date, boolean at least" as refused families. The spec table accepts `boolean` / `toggle` for `sum` and `avg` by recorded ruling (booleans aggregate as numbers on every backend; `AGGREGATION_CASES` pins `sum(flag)=3`, `avg(flag)=0.5`), and the engine door asks that table. Refusing them in lint would be a second list that refuses a pair the runtime answers, so boolean is pinned as a PASS and the refused families are text, date and the others above.
- **`Clause-②:` arm.** The Claim's line is `Clause-②: yes (item 1 widens a published return type of deriveColumnSummary)`, which carries no `(widening)` / `(narrowing)` arm. Beside `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, `check-changeset-no-major` reads that as `contradiction / narrowed-without-arm`, so the changeset and this body declare `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` and keep the Claim's words in the line under it. The title carries `!`.
- **Scope kept to `object-grid` (PM assumption 1).** List-view column summaries (`ListColumn.summary`, `ColumnSummaryConfig.field`) take the same `sum` / `avg` over a non-numeric field, and reach the same door through the grouped header and whole-set summary queries. Their field slot is read by a different member (`validateListViewFieldRefs`, which owns `columns[].summary.field` existence and walks the list-view rungs), so covering them is a second rule; kept out and reported. Measured first-party exposure: 0 refusals — hotcrm `origin/main` `235106f` has 15 `sum` / `avg` column summaries, all over `currency` / `number` fields; `examples/**` has none; the one other hit is a `metadata-core` test contract fixture (`sum` over a formula), not a shipped stack.
- **First-party count (PM assumption 2).** 0 `object-grid` `aggregations` entries are authored anywhere in `examples/**`, `packages/**` (non-test) or hotcrm `origin/main`, so this PR refuses 0 first-party declarations.
- **Not judged here, same table:** `count_distinct` over a JSON-stored field and `min` / `max` over a string-class field are refused by the same door; the ruling scoped this rule to `sum` / `avg`. Follow-up candidate, not filed.
- `ui/packages/plugin-grid` carries no changeset: the edit removes two local type annotations and ships no changed JS.

## Verification

All readings on head `906567ebeb` (origin/main `7d82b2da` is its merge base and had not moved; no merge was needed). Exit codes captured before any pipe.

<details><summary>Derived gate union — 95 families: 92 exit 0, 1 exit 0 on rerun, 2 NOT MEASURED</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 95 commands; each ran with its exit recorded as `CMD :: exit N`.
- `--ran` reconciliation :: exit 0 — "95 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 94 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED".
- `pnpm check:type-check-debt` :: exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, packages not built) on the first pass, exit 0 after the dogfood closure build.
- NOT MEASURED, reason: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` :: exit 3 (six unrelated packages have no `dist/`: studio, client-react, embedder-openai, knowledge-memory, knowledge-ragflow, scenarios); CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` carries it.
- NOT MEASURED, reason: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` :: exit 1, killed with SIGKILL, and its bundle gates report "No console build to weigh" (they read a built `apps/console`); recorded as a run by `--ran`, but it measured nothing. CI's UI jobs carry it. The ui edit is two removed type annotations.
- The shallow clone was deepened (`git fetch --unshallow origin main`) so the `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` fixture is reachable: exit 0.
</details>

<details><summary>Package tests, typecheck, lint</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` :: exit 0 — Test Files 836 passed, Tests 26645 passed, 1 todo.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run` :: exit 0 — Test Files 199 passed, Tests 8449 passed (before the round-1 review fixes); `src/validate-sortable-fields.test.ts` + `src/rule-explanations.test.ts` on the head :: exit 0, 96 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck` :: exit 0 (tsc + check:test-typecheck).
- spec test layer `tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json` (heap 8192): no diagnostic in `view-grouping-query.*`; the package's ledgered debt is unchanged (`check:test-typecheck` green inside `check:generated`).
- `ui/packages/plugin-grid`: `pnpm type-check` :: exit 0, `pnpm test` :: exit 0 (Test Files 279 passed, Tests 2425 passed), `pnpm lint` :: exit 0 (0 errors).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` reported `api-surface/ui.json` and `export-origins/ui.json` stale (the new `ColumnSummaryValue` export); `--fix` regenerated both, committed.
- Reverse check that `ui/` reads the rebuilt `.d.ts`: a probe file assigning `deriveColumnSummary(row, 'min', …)` to `number | null | undefined` failed with TS2322 (`unknown` not assignable) while the `'sum'` line compiled; the probe was deleted.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (one-shot, restored and hash-checked by scripts/ablation-replace.mjs)</summary>

- Lint verdict removed (`if (isAggregateCompatibleWithFieldType(fn, fieldType)) return;` replaced by an unconditional return): 11 tests red (every refusal pin, the remedy pin, the binding pin and the one-line-shape coverage control); restored, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Spec type: `ColumnSummaryMemberValue` made to answer `number` for `min` / `max` too: 4 `expectTypeOf` pins red under `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` (TS2344); restored.
- After review round 1: `{ tied: 'drop' }` removed: the tie pin red; the `FieldType` skip removed: the `id` / non-`FieldType` pin red; both restored. (A first attempt at the second ablation garbled the replacement and was a no-op; it was discarded and re-run.)
</details>

<details><summary>Dogfood (title carries `!`, Clause-② carries the narrowing arm)</summary>

- Closure build `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/dogfood^...' build` under the verify lock :: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the verify lock :: VERDICT command-exit 0 — Test Files 451 passed, 3 skipped (454); Tests 3775 passed, 42 skipped (3817). The log carries `showcase_invoice` schema-sync ERROR lines (sqlite-wasm: "Cannot add a column with non-constant default") from tests that passed; this diff touches no object, driver or seed, and they were not investigated further.
</details>

<details><summary>Contract review (Fable)</summary>

- Round 1: PASS with should-fix; one must-fix (the changeset's `Clause-②:` line had no arm beside `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`), three should-fix (skip a type outside `FieldType` as the door does; the message overstated "400" for a grid handed its rows; tie / extension / typeless skips unpinned), two nits. All fixed in `906567eb`.
- Round 2 (delta): PASS, no findings. The verdict is also posted on this PR.
</details>
